name: std/data
description: Data structures and persistence: generic collections/sort, lists/queues/stacks/trees, the Models/Repositories/Types object framework, CSV, persistent objects, versioning.
residual: GenericMaps and Hashing arrived 2026-09-03: the package had every container that is a line of elements and none that is a lookup, so anything needing one grew its own -- TFClasses has a string dictionary, FoxBasic a symbol table, and neither can hand its map to the other. Same parametric form as GenericCollections, so it compiles to a symbol file and produces an object only when instantiated. Hashing is the pair of procedures a map has to be given; its first version used the rotate-and-xor of FoxBasic and TFClasses and did not spread, which the suite measures rather than assumes.

The modules under `graphical` belong to this package but cannot travel in the headless SDK: their own import closure reaches the window system. The list is checked against the import graph by docker/gen-headless-core.sh, so it cannot go quietly out of date.
Hosts the high-fan-in HUBS pulled out of the misc pile (Repositories fan-in 15, Models 8, Types 6) — they fan out to XML (std/web) and text, so they are correctly mid-tier, not std/base.
OPEN: a data member reaches std/compiler (likely PersistentObjects via reflection/fingerprints). Confirm and either accept the edge or isolate it before stable.
SQL here is the interface; watch for Bohdan's native SQL engine (Pager/BTree/SQLScan/SQLParse) as a future std/sql package.
PrevalenceSystem (Luc Blaeser's persistent object system) and ContextualDependency entered 2026-08-24: persistence and the component framework's dependency rules are this package's subject.
FNHistories (Fabian Nart) entered 2026-08-24: an unbounded general-purpose history is a data structure, and this package is where they live.

Re-homed 2026-08-27 by the shared-type rule (docs/STDLIB.md): a package holds what other packages talk to each other through. See that file for what moved where and why. In: TFClasses from std/base. Out: CSV to std/encoding.

Out on 2026-08-27: 14 module(s) to lib/data-legacy. the standard library keeps what packages talk to each other through, and these are leaves ob get can deliver. Sources still live in source/; `headless` false keeps them out of the SDK payload.

There were three generations of containers here, not two, and the third was in the registry: community/generics is MODULE G(TYPE T, CONST L) by the same author as GenericCollections, with the same Container/Stack/Queue/DEQue/Vector. It is marked superseded there as of 2026-08-27. The rule this package now holds to: one official set of containers, and it is this one.
